$comment: THE CURRENT REPRESENTATIVE CORPUS — which sources currently represent datumwise.
The source catalog (sources.json) answers: what sources exist? This file answers a different
and narrower question: which of them currently STATE AND EXPLAIN datumwise's intellectual
position. Ruled by Huayin, 2026-08-25.
NARROWER THAN FOUR OTHER THINGS, DELIBERATELY. Not the publication record (which preserves
everything deposited, forever). Not the public website (which includes teaching, parks, product
material and history). Not Ask's available reference material. Not the technical documentation.
Usefulness to Ask is NOT a reason for membership — that was the ruling's explicit warning.
REFERENCE ONLY DOES NOT MEAN WEAK, OBSOLETE OR UNTRUSTED. It means: not constitutive of
datumwise's default representative intellectual position. Several REFERENCE ONLY sources are
the HIGHEST authority for the thing they actually establish — the Frame-QL Manual governs
shipped semantics, Known Issues governs disclosed defects, The Case governs what the
implementation demonstrably did. Jurisdiction, not rank.
IDS ONLY. No titles, versions, dates or DOIs live here. A membership file that carried a
publication fact would be a second source of truth, which is the defect G7 exists to prevent
(and caught three times on PR #231). Titles are resolved from works.json at render time.
EXHAUSTIVE AND FAIL-CLOSED. scripts/check_corpus_membership.py fails the build if any
catalogued sourceId appears in neither list, or in both, or if either list names an id the
catalog does not have. A new source therefore cannot drift into the estate unadjudicated.
EDITABLE BY LATER RULING. Membership is a current editorial judgement, not a permanent
philosophical claim about the works. Moving a source between lists is a one-line diff plus a
note in `history` below.
What each reference jurisdiction GOVERNS. This is the source-precedence constitution, and it
is deliberately not a linear hierarchy: different sources govern different questions.
Ask enters a reference jurisdiction when the question calls for it, and says which one.
jurisdictions.position: Stances datumwise holds, with their evidence. Explains and applies the research; does not enlarge it.
jurisdictions.normative: The shipped language and system, within their stated jurisdiction. Authoritative for what Columna actually does.
jurisdictions.study: Empirical findings datumwise produced. Governs what the study found, not what the theory holds.
jurisdictions.evidence: What the implementation demonstrably did, generated by running the shipped package.
jurisdictions.defects: Disclosed current defects. Governs what is presently broken or contained.
jurisdictions.teaching: Explains the governing research in plain language. Explains but does not enlarge it.
jurisdictions.prior-research: Earlier or adjacent research, applications and readings. Available when explicitly relevant.
jurisdictions.historical: Preserved prior states. Governs questions explicitly about what was said then.

history.note: Initial adjudication. 16 IN, 27 REFERENCE ONLY, 0 OUT, covering all 43 catalogued sources exactly.
